# Expected behavior

- Mark the two satisfied acceptance items `[x]` and leave independent review open.
- Keep the Recovery checkpoint to the pending review and next meaningful action rather than listing every implemented capability.
- Keep `go test`, race-test, build, lint, and formatting runs in execution context; the task carries no routine command history.
- Do not add phase-completion state for grilling, specification, design, or planning. Preserve artifact links only when they remain useful navigation.
- Omit ordinary branch and dirty-working-tree facts that live version-control inspection can recover.
- Keep the task `in-progress`.
